q: John Calvin yazaalibwa ddi era wa, era kukuzibwa kwa ngeri ki okwamubumba?
a: Calvin yazaalibwa nga 10 July 1509 mu Noyon, ekibuga eky'essinzizo mu ssaza ery'e Picardy mu Bufaransa. Kitaawe, Gérard Cauvin, yali mukungu w'amateeka eyaweerezanga omulabirizi w'ekitundu, omusajja ow'okwegomba okunene eyasooka okutegeka omwana we owookubiri ow'ebirabo abeere kabona, n'oluvannyuma, ng'embeera ze zikyuse, akwate omulimu ogw'amateeka ogugagawaza ennyo. Calvin yakula ng'omulenzi omwegendereza, akkakkamu era omwagazi w'ebitabo, era empisa ezo zaateeka akabonero ku buli kimu kye yafuuka oluvannyuma.

q: Calvin yatendekebwa kukola ki nga tannafuuka muzzi wa buggya?
a: Ng'aweerezebwa mu Paris ng'akyali mulenzi nga wa myaka kkumi na ena, yayita mu Collège de la Marche ne mu Collège de Montaigu eky'obukalubo, n'afuna diguli ye eya master ng'akyali mu myaka gye egy'obuvubuka. Kitaawe bwe yayomba n'ab'essinzizo e Noyon, yakyusa omwana we okuva mu by'okusoma Katonda okudda mu mateeka, era Calvin n'asomera e Orléans ne Bourges wansi w'abanoonyereza b'amateeka abasinga obulungi mu Bufaransa. Era yanywa nnyo ku kuyiga okuggya okwa humanist, nga yeeyigiriza Oluyonaani n'Olwebbulaniya; ekitabo kye ekyasooka okufulumizibwa tekyali kya ddiini n'akatono, wabula kyali kya kunnyonnyola ekya bwannannyini ku muwandiisi Omuruumi Seneca.

q: Calvin yategeeza ki bwe yayogera ku "kukyuka kwe okw'amangu"?
a: Ebirowoozo eby'enjiri ebyava mu Bugirimaani bwe byali biyingira ku nsalo mu ntandikwa y'emyaka gya 1530, Calvin, ng'atambulira mu bibinja eby'abaagala okuzza obuggya mu Paris, yalaba ettaka nga likyukakyuka wansi w'ebigere bye. Teyayogera bingi ku kulwana kw'emmeeme ye, naye mu nnyingizo ey'okunnyonnyola kwe ku Zabbuli yakinnyonnyola mu sentensi emu: nti Katonda, olw'okukyuka okw'amangu, yakkakkanya n'aleeta ebirowoozo bye mu mbeera eyeegomba okuyigirizibwa, nga byali bikakanyavu okusinga bwe kyandisuubirwa ku muntu ow'emyaka egyo emito. Tawa lunaku, tawa kifo, tawa kwolesebwa — wabula nti Katonda yamuwangula, era bwe yamala okuwangulwa teyayinza kudda mabega.

q: Lwaki Calvin yava mu Bufaransa, era yatuuka atya okuwandiika Institutes?
a: Okuyigganyizibwa kw'abaagala enjiri bwe kweyongera mu Bufaransa, Calvin yadduka, ng'atambulira mu mannya ag'obulimba okuva mu kibuga ekimu okudda mu kirala, era mu 1535 n'abeera akaseera mu Basel. Eyo, ng'akyali mu myaka gye egy'amakumi abiri mu wakati, yawandiika ekitabo ekisooka ekya Institutes of the Christian Religion, ekyafulumizibwa mu 1536 — ennyonnyola entegeke era ennambulukufu ey'okukkiriza okw'enjiri, ng'akiwaayo ekitundu ng'okwewolereza ku lwa banne abaayigganyizibwanga mu maaso ga kabaka w'e Bufaransa. Kyatandika ng'akatabo akatono, naye mu myaka amakumi abiri mu esatu egyaddirira n'akiddamu n'akigaziya emirundi n'emirundi okutuusa, mu ngeri yaakyo ey'enkomerero eya 1559, bwe kyayimirira ng'ennyanjula esinga obujjuvu ku njigiriza ya Reformed eyali ewandiikiddwa.

q: Calvin yatuuka atya e Geneva, era kiki ekyasooka okubaawo?
a: Mu kyeya kya 1536, ng'ateekedde kusula kiro kimu kyokka mu Geneva ng'ali ku lugendo e Strasbourg, yategeerwa. Guillaume Farel, omuzzi w'obuggya ow'omuliro eyali aggyeeko ekibuga ku Rooma naye nga talina birabo bya kuzimba ekyo ekyali kiteekwa okudda mu kifo kyakyo, yeegayirira Calvin asigale; Calvin bwe yeewolereza olw'okuyiga kwe n'okwetaaga kwe akasirise, Farel yaboggola nti Katonda yandikolimidde okuyiga okwo singa adduka omulimu gwe yayitibwa mu bwerufu, era Calvin, ng'akwatiddwa, n'asigala. Ku ntandikwa kyagenda bubi: ye ne Farel baawaliriza enkyukakyuka ekibuga ze kyali tekinnaba kugumira, era mu 1538 abaami b'ekibuga ne babagoba bombi.

q: Calvin yakola ki mu myaka gye e Strasbourg?
a: Eri Calvin okugobwa kwawulikika si ng'okuwangulwa wabula ng'obununuzi — yasobola okudda eri ebitabo bye. Yagenda e Strasbourg n'amala emyaka esatu egiyinza okuba nga gye gyasinga okusanyusa mu bulamu bwe, ng'alunda ekkuŋŋaaniro ery'abanoonyi b'obubudamu Abafaransa wansi w'omuzzi w'obuggya omukkakkamu Martin Bucer, ng'asomesa, era ng'ayiga engeri ekkanisa gy'eteekwa okuddukanyizibwamu. Eyo, mu Agasito 1540, gye yawasiza Idelette de Bure, nnamwandu w'Omwanabaptist eyakyuka era omukazi ow'amaanyi ag'akasirise eyafuuka, mu bigambo bye, omuyambi omwesigwa mu buweereza bwe; omwana waabwe omuwere Jacques yawangaala ennaku ntono zokka mu 1542, era Idelette yennyini n'afa mu Marisi 1549.

q: Obuweereza bwa Calvin bwali butya oluvannyuma lw'okuyitibwa okudda e Geneva?
a: Geneva, ng'etabusetabuse awatali ye, yamuyita akomewo mu 1541, era wadde nga buli kimu mu ye kyawakanya — yawandiika nti yandisinze okufa emirundi kikumi okusinga okuddamu okwetikka omusaalaba ogwo — yeewaayo n'akomawo mu Ssebuttemba, n'asigalawo awatali kuwummula emyaka amakumi abiri mu esatu egyamusigalira. Teyalina bufuzi era teyafuuka mutuuze okutuusa okumpi n'enkomerero; yali musumba n'omusomesa bwe atyo, ng'abuulira kumpi buli lunaku era ng'ayita mu bitabo bya Bayibuli olunyiriri ku lunyiriri. Yawandiika ennyonnyola ku kumpi Ebyawandiikibwa byonna, yakola empandiika nnene ennyo n'Abapolotesitanti abaayigganyizibwanga mu Bulaaya, era n'ategeka ekkanisa okwetooloola abasumba, abasomesa, abakadde, n'abadiyakoni ab'okulabirira abaavu.

q: Calvin yayigiriza ki ku bufuzi bwa Katonda n'okulabirira kwe?
a: Wakati mu ddiini ya Calvin waali wayimiridde obukakafu nti Katonda ddala ye Mukama ow'amaanyi ow'ebintu byonna — nti tewali kigwawo lwa kigwa bugwi, era nti okubudaabudibwa kwonna okw'omukkiriza kuli mu kuwummulira wansi w'obulabirizi bwa Kitaawe afuga buli mbeera. Yakwatako nti okulabirira kwa Katonda si kulabirira kwa wala era okwa bulijjo, wabula kufuga kwa kumpi era okwa kinnoomu okw'ensi, era n'ayigiriza nti okusaba gwe mulimu omukulu ogw'okukkiriza, engeri eya buli lunaku abakkiriza gye bakwatamu ebyo Katonda bye yasuubiza. Akabonero ke — omukono oguwanika omutima oguliko omuliro, oguweebwayo eri Katonda mangu era n'omutima omulamu — kye kifaananyi ekisinga obwangu eky'okwewaayo okwo.

q: Tutegeera tutya okuttibwa kwa Michael Servetus?
a: Mu 1553 omusawo Omusipanya Michael Servetus, eyali eegaanyi Obusatu era eyanyiiganga Calvin okumala emyaka, yakwatibwa mu Geneva, n'asalirwa omusango, era n'ayokebwa ku muti nga 27 Okitobba. Calvin yanoonya okumusalira omusango era n'akkiriza okufa kwe, era wadde yasaba abaami b'ekibuga okumukwatirwa ekisa bamutemeko omutwe mu kifo ky'omuliro, baagaana. Ensala eyo yagabanwa kumpi abakulembeze bonna ab'omu kiseera ekyo eky'obukambwe, Abakatuliki n'Abapolotesitanti, naye ekyali kintu kya nnaku okuteeka ku njiri ey'ekisa Calvin gye yabuulira; tekimuyamba kukikweka, era omusajja oyo eyawandiika mu ngeri ekwata ku mutima ku bukwatampola bwa Katonda yayinza okuba omukalubo, era yakimanya.

q: Obulamu n'omulimu gwa Calvin byakoma bitya?
a: Mu 1559 yasaanikira emirimu gye ng'atandikawo Academy of Geneva, essomero n'ettendekero eryaddiza ababuulizi abaatendekebwa okudda mu Bufaransa, Scotland, Netherlands n'ebweru. Omubiri gwe gwali tegukoze maanyi, era emyaka egy'omulimu ogutaggwaawo gyagumenya mangu n'omutwe okuluma, omusujja, endwadde y'amagumba, amayinja mu nsigo n'endwadde y'amawuggwe; yabuulira okubuulira kwe okw'enkomerero mu Feburuwali 1564 era n'afa nga 27 May, nga tannaweza myaka amakumi ataano mu etaano. Ku kwewaliriza kwe yaziikibwa mu ntaana etaliiko kabonero, waleme kubaawo kifo kya kussaamu kitiibwa ekiyinza okukuŋŋaana ku magumba ge — ne kaakano tewali amanyi kifo ddala — kubanga yayagala kyokka Katonda agulumizibwe, ye yeerabirwe.
